name: RelayShield — Employee Credential Early Warning
description: Checks employee email addresses against RelayShield's breach database AND live criminal Telegram channel intelligence. Telegram IOC hits fire 24–72 hours before public breach databases — giving your SOC a head start while the attack is still forming.

agents.name: Receive Employee Email
agents.description: Trigger this story by sending a POST with {"email": "employee@company.com"}. Wire to your HR system, identity provider, or run manually per employee.

agents.name: 1 — Breach Check (HIBP)
agents.description: Check the email against known breach databases via RelayShield. Returns breach count, source names, and exposed data types.

agents.name: 2 — Telegram Intel Check (24–72hr Lead)
agents.description: Query RelayShield's live Telegram criminal channel intelligence. Monitors verified criminal Telegram channels — infostealer log markets, credential dump channels, SIM swap listings. Returns hits 24–72 hours before HIBP.

agents.name: 3 — Evaluate Severity
agents.description: Determine alert severity. Telegram hit = CRITICAL (attack forming). Breach-only = HIGH (standard response). Both = CRITICAL. Clean = no action.

payload.severity: {% if 2_telegram_intel_check_24_72hr_lead.body.matched == true %}CRITICAL{% elsif 1_breach_check_hibp.body.data.found == true %}HIGH{% else %}CLEAN{% endif %}
payload.headline: {% if 2_telegram_intel_check_24_72hr_lead.body.matched == true %}🚨 CRITICAL — Credential spotted in criminal Telegram channels before public disclosure{% elsif 1_breach_check_hibp.body.data.found == true %}⚠️ HIGH — Employee credential found in breach database{% else %}✅ CLEAN — No exposure detected{% endif %}

agents.name: Route — CRITICAL (Telegram Hit)
agents.description: Fires when the email appears in a criminal Telegram channel. Attack is forming — SOC has 24–72hr window to act before HIBP picks it up.

agents.name: Route — HIGH (Breach Only)
agents.description: Fires when the email appears in a known breach database but not yet in Telegram channels. Standard breach response workflow.

agents.name: CRITICAL — Slack SOC Alert
agents.description: Send CRITICAL alert to SOC Slack channel. Includes Telegram source channel, category, first-seen timestamp, and recommended immediate actions.

text.text:
*Why CRITICAL:* This credential appeared in a criminal Telegram channel *before* public breach databases. Your SOC has a 24–72 hour window to act. The attack is forming — not yet executing.

*Immediate actions:*
• Force password reset on all corporate systems
• Revoke active sessions (Google, M365, VPN)
• Check for MFA bypass attempts in auth logs
• Notify employee — do not wait for breach confirmation
_Powered by RelayShield Threat Intelligence — continuously monitored criminal Telegram channels · api.relayshield.net_

agents.description: Send HIGH alert to SOC Slack channel for standard breach response.

diagram_notes.content:
## RelayShield — Employee Credential Early Warning

Detects employee credential exposure in criminal Telegram channels **24–72 hours before HIBP**.

**CRITICAL path:** Telegram hit → attack is forming → immediate SOC response
**HIGH path:** Breach-only hit → standard remediation workflow

**Setup required:**
- `RelayShield_API_Key` credential (get at api.relayshield.net)
- `Slack_Webhook_URL` credential (your SOC channel)
- Optionally replace Slack agents with PagerDuty, ServiceNow, or Jira

**Intelligence source:** Verified criminal Telegram channels monitored in real time — infostealer log markets, credential dump channels, Web3 threat feeds.
